description: Character-level 3D rotation with deterministic glyph substitution (decryption). GSAP `back.out` ease + per-glyph `onUpdate` for the flicker hash.
Slot-machine vertical scrolling using stepped GSAP tweens within a masked column.
Counter where font size grows with the value for escalating emphasis. Single GSAP tween on a numeric proxy.
Replace entire text states at time thresholds for non-linear typing (typos, holds, bulk additions, backspaces). GSAP onUpdate-driven reverse search.
Highlight keywords with glow + scale + color synced to ASR word timestamps. Two GSAP tweens per word drive a CSS custom property `--glow` through attack-decay-rest envelope.
Multiple offset text layers (N divs at `(i*dx, i*dy)` with decreasing alpha) create a stacked 3D extrusion illusion on large typography.
Typing cursor whose `background-color` switches at segment boundaries plus square-wave blink via `(tl.time() % cycle) < cycle/2`.

Pre-compute a flat `[{startTime, endTime, ...}]` array from a script of `{textMain, textAccent, charSpeed, hold}` entries. Each phrase's window = `chars × charSpeed + hold`. Content-driven duration, no hand-tuned offsets.

Percussive kinetic typography — short phrases slam in on ONE shared beat array with DISTINCT per-phrase entrances (scale-slam / side-snap / rise-rotate), optional rhythm chrome (metronome ticks, beat bar), then a locked finale. The recipe for "punchy / rhythmic" taglines.
Counter whose font size grows with the value; seek-safe `onUpdate`, `Math.round`, `tabular-nums`, multi-stat chord. (Also listed under Text & Typography.)

Data-viz primitives that pair a number with a graphic — growth bars (CSS `scaleY` stagger), progress fill (bar `scaleX` or measured SVG ring), and fractional star-rating wipe (`clip-path`). Transforms only, seek-safe. Pick single-focus vs split-frame and hold it.
Zoom into non-centered elements via scale (outer wrapper) + counter-translation (inner wrapper).

Two-phase virtual camera that locks the viewport to a moving focal point (typing cursor) — static initial framing then focal-point-locked tracking. Uses browser-native `getBoundingClientRect()` / `ctx.measureText()` after `document.fonts.ready`.
Sequential camera-zoom system (pull-back / focus / push) plus continuous micro-drift.

Virtual camera — simulate zoom / pan / focus-lock by transforming a single `.world` wrapper containing all scene content. Single-element composite transform `translate(x,y) scale(S)`; counter-translate math is `T = -offset × S` (DIFFERENT from coordinate-target-zoom's `T = -offset`).

Selective rack-focus — GSAP-tween `filter: blur()` (+ slight opacity dim) on off-focus layers via a `--dof` var while the focal element stays sharp; single pull, two-plane rack, or blur-the-cluster-while-pushing-in. Finite, deterministic, seek-safe.
Avatars on an elliptical ring with SVG connection lines to a center point, staggered entry. Cloud center coordinates must match the centerpiece element exactly.
Full webpage rendered as a tilted 3D card whose internal content scrolls to reveal specific sections. Pair with asr-keyword-glow for on-page keyword highlighting.

Elements start clustered at screen center and expand outward to final positions. Each element gets its target position via CSS once; GSAP tweens transform `x` / `y` offsets to 0 in lockstep with a shared driver.
Two cards side-by-side with opposing rotationY tilts (+/- baseTilt) and entry slides from their respective sides. Continuous floating runs in phase opposition (`Math.PI` offset).

Elements flip in from 3D space (`rotateX` + `rotateY` + `translateZ`) then settle into a continuous elliptical orbit. **Critical**: entry MUST flip in-place at the orbital starting position (`gsap.set` BEFORE phase 1), not at scene center.

AI detection overlay — yellow `#facc15` L-bracket corners + confidence label (fluctuating 95-99%) following a target on a sine arc path. Box position recomputed per-frame from target position (never tweened separately).

N elements scatter into / reassemble from a rotating 3D depth-cloud — each starts at a deterministic index-derived 3D offset (translateZ + rotateX/Y + scatter) and settles to a clean flat layout; tumble-swap and radial-explode variants. preserve-3d + perspective, transform-only, seek-safe.

Animate internal SVG elements (rotating hands, oscillating blades, pulsing dots, dash-flow lines) so icons feel alive. **Critical**: use SVG `setAttribute('transform', 'rotate(deg cx cy)')` for explicit center — CSS `transform-origin` + `transform-box: fill-box` interprets origin in bbox-local coords (off-center for thin lines).

SVG outline draws itself stroke-by-stroke via `stroke-dasharray` / `stroke-dashoffset`. Measure with `getTotalLength()` at composition setup, set initial dashoffset = length, GSAP tweens to 0. For circular progress rings, rotate the stroke `-90deg` so drawing starts at 12 o'clock.

Continuous breathing/idle ambient motion. Two forms: GSAP `sine.inOut` yoyo with finite repeats (preferred when standalone) or onUpdate reading `tl.time()` (preferred when multiplying onto another live value).

Un-triggered soft radial glow that blooms in behind a hero element and holds with a bounded idle breathe, or a single-pass traveling sheen across a surface. No click, no word-sync; peak opacity ≤ ~0.45, finite/deterministic.

Physical-collision transition where an entering element's GSAP tween drives the exiting element's displacement. Three concurrent tweens at the same timeline position with victim durations 40-50% of the intruder's.

Tactile button press: linear compression then spring recovery via two adjacent GSAP tweens on the same property. Variations: color transition, shadow depth via CSS vars, release burst, background glow.

Physical click simulation — two sequential GSAP scale tweens (down to 0.9, up to 1.0) approximate a spring with overshoot. Pass a single targets array `["#cta", "#cursor"]` to compress both together for tactile contact feel.

Animated cursor moves to a target, depresses cursor + target together on click, emits an expanding ripple with attack-decay opacity envelope. Element lives in DOM from t=0 with `opacity: 0` (no conditional rendering).
Coordinated morph between two DOM elements at the same screen center. Exit cluster shrinks + fades; entrance pops in with `back.out(2)` overshoot.

Container morphs apparent size + corner radius + surface treatment between two shots, then fades to reveal the real target underneath. HyperFrames substitutes uniform `scale` for the forbidden `width`/`height` tween, plus paint-only `borderRadius`/`background`/`boxShadow`.

The canonical ENTRANCE pop — an element (or staggered group) arrives by springing `scale: 0 → 1` with `back.out` overshoot, `fromTo` so it's correct at t=0 under seek. Single hero, staggered group (≤500ms cap), overshoot tuned by personality. Distinct from `press-release-spring` (a click/press reaction).

Fake directional velocity blur on a fast entrance / camera push-through — blur peaks at max speed, resolves to 0 at the settle. Two paths: SVG `feGaussianBlur` stdDeviation on the motion axis (proxy-tweened), or a deterministic echo/ghost trail that collapses into the lead. Entrances / mid-shot only.
Drop-in GSAP timeline patterns — typewriter, audio visualizer, and other reusable choreography blocks.

Pure CSS + GSAP implementations of marker-highlight drawing modes — highlight (yellow sweep), circle (hand-drawn ellipse), burst (radiating lines), scribble (chaotic), sketchout (rough rectangle outline).
